findings.description: Gertrudis Hoffmans (recorded in the hint as Geertrudis Gerits) and Petrus Jansen had a daughter, Elisabeth Jansen, baptized 30 March 1713 in Wanroij, North Brabant — between their sons Joannes (christened 1709) and Gerardus (christened 1711) / Joannes (christened 1717).

target_person.name: Elisabeth Jansen
